landing.title: Download video and audio privately
landing.subtitle: Download video, extract audio, and save real GIF output with up to 8K on YouTube and source-dependent quality across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Bilibili, VK Video, Giphy, and public media links.
landing.authError: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
landing.secure: Secure Google login with private session management
landing.noCloudDefault: No permanent cloud storage or file logging by default
landing.step4: Queue and save to your device
landing.comparisonSubtitle: Each platform serves media differently. Here is what is analyzed and extracted across platforms.
landing.ytVideo: Up to 8K (4320p) / 4K (2160p) / 60 FPS when source exposes it
landing.ytAudio: Dedicated audio streams (AAC / Opus up to 160 kbps)
landing.igAudio: DASH stream or converted to MP3 (128-192 kbps)
landing.igSize: Calculated from bitrate or determined during stream
landing.fbVideo: Full HD (1080p), HD, and SD resolutions
landing.fbGif: Only when the source identifies GIF media
landing.fbSize: Calculated during stream or estimated from duration
landing.xVideo: Up to 1080p / 720p (public clips from source CDN)
landing.xAudio: Converted to MP3 from video audio track
landing.xSize: Estimated from post stream metadata & CDN delivery
landing.bilibiliVideo: Up to 1080p Full HD (public non-restricted videos)
landing.bilibiliAudio: Dedicated AAC audio or converted to high-quality MP3
landing.vkVideo: Up to 4K (2160p) / 25 FPS when the public source exposes it
landing.vkAudio: Dedicated AAC / Opus streams up to 265 kbps
landing.vkSize: Determined from source metadata or during streaming
landing.giphyVideo: MP4 preview stream when Giphy exposes it
landing.giphySize: Determined from the public CDN response
